title: Migration check step must run every migration-* service and report per-service failures
answers: migration check fails with a generic exit code and I can't tell which database failed
how do I add or debug a migration-mssql or migration-postgres CI check
why does the database migration CI job only show a timeout without naming the service
CI migration job stops after first failing database service
body:
Symptom: The CI database migration job fails with a generic exit code, and the log does not name which database (e.g. mssql) failed or why.
Invariant: The 'Run migration check' step in .github/workflows/master.yml runs every service returned by `tests/db/compose.sh config --services` whose name starts with `migration-`, keeps going after a failure, prints a per-service ✅/❌ summary, and exits non-zero if any service failed.
Enforcement: .github/workflows/master.yml 'Run migration check' step (the `if ... run ... else status=$?` branch records the failure, emits `::error::Migration check failed for <service> (exit code N)`, and ends with `exit "$failed"`).
What breaks if skipped: Stopping at the first failing service hides the other databases' results. Exiting without the error annotation leaves only a generic job failure to diagnose.
Constraints: New migration services are picked up automatically by the `grep '^migration-'` filter, so name new ones with that prefix. Do not switch back to a shell `trap ... ERR` flag, which this change replaced. The annotation and summary are only useful if the step keeps the per-service exit code.
applies: Applies to the migration check step in master.yml and to any CI step that loops over compose services and must report each one.
says: The automated build fails migrations without naming which database had the error.
Database migration checks should continue running so every database status is reported.
Show an individual pass or fail summary for every database in the build.
The build pipeline aborts on the first database failure instead of testing all.
search: The 'Run migration check' step in .github/workflows/master.yml must run every compose service from `tests/db/compose.sh config --services` starting with `migration-`, continue after failures, emit `::error::Migration check failed for <service> (exit code N)`, and exit non-zero if any failed. It records per-service exit codes rather than using a shell `trap ... ERR` flag to preserve individual failure details. New services must use the `migration-` prefix to be discovered automatically.
